motifs.tf_motif_rule: JASPAR names split on ::, case-insensitive; a TF with several motifs takes the mean of their standardised MA

scan.window: fixed 500 bp at each merged near-landmark peak midpoint, clipped (review 054 C1)

halves.rule: 93.8: usable samples (parsed, >= 1 interval) in URL order; A = positions 0, 2, 4 of the usable list, B = 1, 3, 5; cells with has only; F_reg from MA standardised with the full-union mean and sd
